user.title: PHS16-LC
user.description: RS-485 full-duplex bus of PHS16-LC luminaires. Plug in the USB-RS422 (FTDI) adapter before continuing.

data.expected_spots: Expected number of SPOTs (0 = scan stops at first silence; lumiatec: full 1..255 sweep)
data.rx_port: RX serial port (optional — dual box with 2x USB-RS485-WE)

data_description.port: Linux: /dev/ttyUSB0 (or /dev/phs16bus with a udev rule). macOS (dev): /dev/cu.usbserial-XXXX.
data_description.expected_spots: Set the total number of luminaires to detect a failed card in the middle of the line.
data_description.poll_interval: The PHS16-LC protocol has no push: currents and temperatures are re-read at this interval.
data_description.recipes_dir: Copy the recipes/*.json files from the project there; they feed the "Recipe" dropdowns.
data_description.rx_port: Leave empty for a single full-duplex converter (TX = RX). With the manufacturer dual box: TX port in "Serial port", RX port here.

abort.already_configured: This serial port is already configured.

init.title: PHS16-LC options
init.description: Applied live: the entry is reloaded automatically after saving. If the port changes, the old port is closed and the new one opened.

data.rx_port: RX port (optional — dual box with 2x USB-RS485-WE)
data.expected_spots: Expected number of SPOTs (0 = scan stops at first silence; lumiatec: full 1..255 sweep)

data_description.port: Linux: /dev/ttyUSB0 (or /dev/phs16bus with a udev rule). macOS (dev): /dev/cu.usbserial-XXXX.
data_description.rx_port: Empty = single full-duplex converter (TX = RX). Dual box: RX port here, TX port in "Serial port".

error.already_configured: This serial port is already used by another PHS16-LC entry.

scan.name: Scan the line
scan.description: Searches for PHS16-LC cards present on the bus (addresses 1..N).

apply_recipe.name: Apply a recipe
apply_recipe.description: Applies a recipe to one card, to all (address=all) or to a whole luminaire group (address=group:<id>).

address.name: Address
address.description: Card number (e.g. "1"), "all" (all cards) or "group:<id>" (luminaire group defined in groups.json).

group.name: Group
group.description: Optional: apply only this channel group (partial application).

apply_scene.name: Apply a scene
apply_scene.description: Applies a scene file to several cards at once.

file.name: Scene file
file.description: File name in the scenes folder (e.g. "serre.json").

save.name: Save to NVM
save.description: Sends @WP after each card (makes currents permanent).

save.name: Save to NVM
save.description: Makes the card's current channel currents permanent in non-volatile memory (@WP).

save_recipe.name: Save as recipe
save_recipe.description: Writes the current currents of a SPOT into a new recipe JSON file (`channels` vector of 16 mA values) in the recipes folder.

name.name: Name
name.description: Recipe name (basename of the .json file created).

address.name: Address
address.description: Card number (e.g. "1") whose currents are saved.

description.name: Description
description.description: Optional description stored in the recipe.

currents.name: Currents (mA)
currents.description: Optional: explicit vector, e.g. "800,800,0,..." (card slider positions). Otherwise: currents read at the last poll.

overwrite.name: Overwrite
overwrite.description: true to overwrite an existing recipe of the same name (refuses by default).

set_channels.name: Set channels
set_channels.description: Sets each channel individually (16 values in mA, 0 = off, 74-2150 mA).

currents.name: Currents (mA)
currents.description: 16 values separated by spaces or commas (e.g. "800 800 0 0 ...").

set_channel.name: Set one channel
set_channel.description: Sets a single channel of a card.

set_group.name: Create / edit a light group
set_group.description: Creates or edits a group of luminaires (members, name, color, icon, area) by rewriting groups.json — hot-reloaded, no restart. Call this service from Developer tools → Actions to attach or detach luminaires to a group from the UI.

group_id.name: Group id
group_id.description: Technical id (A-Z a-z 0-9 _ -), e.g. "greenhouse_1_north". Created if it does not exist.

new_group_id.name: New id (rename)
new_group_id.description: Optional: renames the group (existing entities follow).

name.name: Display name
name.description: Optional: group name (empty = falls back to the id). Omitted = unchanged.

spots.name: Member luminaires
spots.description: Multiple selection of SPOT lights (light.spot_*): replaces the group member list (attach/detach).

addresses.name: Addresses (text)
addresses.description: Alternative to `spots`: comma-separated addresses (e.g. "1,2,3") or "all" (all known SPOTs). Replaces the member list.

color.name: Badge color
color.description: Color of the HA label (e.g. "#4CAF50"). Empty = clear. Omitted = unchanged.

icon.name: Badge icon
icon.description: Icon of the HA label (e.g. "mdi:leaf"). Empty = clear. Omitted = unchanged.

area.name: Area
area.description: Area set on the member devices and the group device. Empty = clear. Omitted = unchanged.

port.name: Bus (serial port)
port.description: Optional: target bus when several PHS16-LC entries exist (e.g. "/dev/ttyUSB0"). Default: the bus that already knows the group, else the first one.

remove_group.name: Remove a light group
remove_group.description: Removes a group of luminaires from groups.json (hot-reloaded). Its entities become unavailable; the luminaires themselves are untouched.

group_id.name: Group id
group_id.description: Id of the group to remove, e.g. "greenhouse_1_north".

port.name: Bus (serial port)
port.description: Optional: target bus when several PHS16-LC entries exist. Default: the bus that knows the group, else the first one.
